how_to_apply: Visit the official IISc website at www.iisc.ac.in.
Open the Careers section and select Contractual Positions.
Locate Advertisement No. R(HR)Temp-13(JSA-S&FF)/2026 for Junior Security Assistant (On Contract).
Read the original recruitment notification and Corrigendum II dated 29 October 2026.
Open the official online application portal.
Register using the available account creation facility or log in with existing credentials.
Select the Junior Security Assistant recruitment advertisement.
Enter the required personal, educational, service-background and other application details.
Upload the prescribed certificates supporting age, qualification, service, category and other applicable eligibility claims.
Upload the valid two-wheeler driving licence in the "Any Other Relevant Certificates" field.
Review the completed application and verify all entered information.
Submit the online application by 15 November 2026.
Save or print the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: IISc Junior Security Assistant Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: IISc Bengaluru has announced 30 Junior Security Assistant vacancies on a contractual basis in its Security and Fire Fighting Department.

content_sections.heading: IISc Junior Security Assistant Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must have passed SSLC/Matriculation or an equivalent examination and satisfy the prescribed military, Agniveer or CAPF service-background requirements. A valid two-wheeler driving licence is also compulsory. Important Agniveer Provision: The four-year service and discharge requirements are subject to the expressly notified exception for first-batch Combatant Agniveers who have not yet completed their engagement. Candidates applying under this provision should follow the supporting-document requirements of the application portal. Applicants must possess a valid two-wheeler driving licence. IISc specifically instructs candidates to upload the licence in the "Any Other Relevant Certificates" field of the online application portal.

content_sections.heading: IISc Junior Security Assistant Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Selected Junior Security Assistants will receive Rs. 35,000 per month as consolidated remuneration under the contractual engagement.

content_sections.heading: IISc Junior Security Assistant Contract Duration 2026
content_sections.text: The engagement is initially for one year on a contractual basis and may be renewed annually up to a maximum of five years, depending on satisfactory performance and IISc requirements. The contract tenure begins from the date of joining. For candidates previously engaged by IISc through HR Department appointments, the relevant prior service will count towards the maximum five-year contractual tenure. Important: This is not a regular or permanent government appointment. The notification specifically excludes claims for regular service benefits such as pension, seniority, promotion and the other benefits mentioned in the contractual conditions.

rows.details: Annually, Subject to Performance and Institute Requirements

content_sections.heading: IISc Junior Security Assistant Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises a Physical Efficiency Test and Trade Test, followed by an Interview for shortlisted candidates. Application Screening: IISc will examine applications against the prescribed qualification, service background, age and other requirements. Physical Efficiency Test: Candidates will undergo the prescribed physical assessment. Trade Test: Candidates will be assessed in the relevant security-related skills. Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview. Medical Fitness: Contractual engagement will be subject to medical fitness and verification of eligibility. The selection process will be conducted at IISc Bengaluru on dates to be announced separately. Shortlisted candidates will be informed through their registered email addresses.

content_sections.heading: IISc Junior Security Assistant Job Responsibilities
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be responsible for campus security and associated operational duties in the Security and Fire Fighting Department. Control entry and exit of personnel, visitors and vehicles at designated campus gates. Conduct regular campus security patrols. Monitor CCTV cameras, alarms and other security systems. Report suspicious activities and security incidents promptly. Respond to fire, medical and other emergencies in coordination with the department. Assist with crowd management and traffic regulation during institute events and VIP visits. Maintain security logs, visitor records and incident reports. Operate security and communication equipment. Perform assigned security duties during rotational shifts, including night shifts.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for IISc Junior Security Assistant Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must provide the applicable supporting documents during online application and subsequent verification. SSLC / Matriculation or equivalent certificate and marksheet. Valid two-wheeler driving licence. Prescribed service or discharge certificate for eligible Ex-Servicemen, Ex-CAPF personnel or Ex-Agniveers. Relevant supporting service documents for first-batch Combatant Agniveers applying under the special eligibility provision. Age-proof certificate. Valid SC/ST/OBC/EWS certificate, if claiming reservation. Supporting certificates for age relaxation, if applicable. Other relevant documents requested through the official application portal. EWS Certificate: Candidates claiming EWS reservation must possess an Income and Asset Certificate valid for 2026-27, issued based on income for the financial year 2025-26, according to the advertised requirements. Category certificates must be produced in the prescribed format at document verification. Applicants should ensure that the category selected in the application matches their valid supporting certificate.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Science (IISc), Bengaluru, for temporary contract positions within their campus in the state of Karnataka.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post offered in IISc Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post offered in this recruitment drive is Junior Security Assistant (On Contract) under advertisement number R(HR)Temp-13(JSA-S&FF)/2026.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 30 vacancies available for the Junior Security Assistant (On Contract) post, distributed across various categories including UR, OBC, SC, ST, and EWS.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for IISc Junior Security Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: According to Corrigendum II dated 29 October 2026, the last date for online applications has been extended to 15 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an SSLC/Matriculation or equivalent qualification along with at least 04 years of service as Combatant Ex-Agniveers, Ex-servicemen, or Ex-CAPF personnel, plus a valid two-wheeler driving license.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for IISc Junior Security Assistant candidates?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 30 years. Age relaxations are applicable as per Government of India norms for eligible category candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary provided for the Junior Security Assistant position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 35,000/- per month throughout their contract period at IISc Bengaluru.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for IISc Junior Security Assistant Recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a Physical Efficiency Test, a Trade Test, and a personal Interview to evaluate the physical fitness and professional competence of candidates.

faq.question: Q9. How can eligible candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official IISc temporary positions recruitment portal by filling out the application form and uploading necessary supporting certificates.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website and notification link?
faq.answer: You can access the official notification PDF, online application link, and the official website directly from the Important Links section provided in this article.
